openai.instructions: Narrate a product video. Warm, confident and unhurried; clear articulation, natural pauses at commas and dashes. Not salesy, not robotic.

lines.text: Meet the product: one line that says what it is.
The old way is over. Here is the new way.
A caption says what the picture is showing.
Each line is spoken while its scene is on screen.
The product. The one thing to do next. Powered by Yuma.
